s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive orbital syndrome with cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Left proptosis and resistance to globe retropulsion
Left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus
key_facts: Recurring forehead lesion first excised 6 years prior to presentation
Initial histopathologic findings showed a Breslow thickness of 6 mm
Left upper eyelid edema, erythema, and ptosis
Forehead anesthesia in the V1 division of the trigeminal nerve

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive orbital syndrome with cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Left proptosis and resistance to globe retropulsion
Left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus
key_facts: Recurring forehead lesion first excised 6 years prior to presentation
Initial histopathologic findings showed a Breslow thickness of 6 mm
Left upper eyelid edema, erythema, and ptosis
Forehead anesthesia in the V1 division of the trigeminal nerve

shortlist.label: Malignant melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathologic findings and biopsy results consistent with malignant melanoma

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Orbital mass extending to the cavernous sinus, consistent with meningioma involvement

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Perineural and intraneural invasion, consistent with schwannoma characteristics

shortlist.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cranial nerve involvement and orbital mass, consistent with esthesioneuroblastoma presentation

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic disease with orbital involvement, lymphoma a possible consideration

raw.rationale: The patient's history of a recurring forehead lesion with initial histopathologic findings showing a Breslow thickness of 6 mm, 14 mitotic figures/mm2, and extensive perineural and intraneural invasion, along with the recent biopsy of the frontal nerve showing malignant cells, strongly supports the diagnosis of malignant melanoma.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Meningioma does not typically present with a history of a recurring skin lesion or perineural invasion.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannoma is a benign tumor that does not typically exhibit malignant features like mitotic activity or perineural invasion.

rejected.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
rejected.why: Esthesioneuroblastoma is a rare tumor that typically presents with nasal symptoms, not a recurring forehead lesion.

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: Lymphoma does not typically present with perineural invasion or a history of a recurring skin lesion with malignant histopathologic features.
